noise_model_documentation.omitted_mechanisms_impact_note: Non-computational |2> leakage (and hyperfine Zeeman leakage on trapped ions) is not explicitly simulated in the 2-level computational Hilbert space. On physical transmons without active Leakage Reduction Units (LRUs), leakage during strong mid-circuit readout or two-qubit CZ drives creates multi-round time-correlated space-time hook/syndrome streaks that reduce effective fault distance and raise the asymptotic logical error floor epsilon_L at large round counts R.

stop_go_decision.governance_note: Offline SIMULATED stop/go crossing gate only (0 QPU seconds, provider_job_id=None). Postselected outcomes (arm3) and acceptance rates A(R) are isolated from unconditional arms (arm1, arm2, arm4a, arm4b), and offline Pauli-frame tracking (arm4a) is labeled separately from physical feed-forward (arm4b). A single code distance (d=3) answers the crossing question for that size only. Scaling with distance remains open in this gate, and a single-size result is not evidence of scalable fault tolerance.
